fusions.name: Out of the Reeds
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: you spring on it from up to 6 tiles away for 24 damage, up to 1.5 times that from full range, and your grip slows it by 30% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly-Flop Landing
fusions.desc: Lands in a splash that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, strips 10% armour for 5 seconds, slows each by 25% and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Each is left [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lily Pad Hop
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
